text:
Jordan: Kicking off prep for the May webinar — thinking ‘Scaling inference for product teams’ but want to pivot to a short main talk + 3 micro-breakouts. thoughts?
Anya: love the micro-breakouts idea. keeps attention and helps routing leads by use-case. :white_check_mark:
Sam: agree. suggested breakout topics: 1) cost optimization + batching, 2) private deployments & compliance, 3) observability + regressions.
Mira: +1. can we make each breakout 12 mins + 3 min Q? keeps + demo tight.
Jordan: exactly. draft run-of-show below — please eyeball:```
00:00 - Intro (Jordan) 5m
05:00 - Keynote talk (Anya) 20m
25:00 - Breakout pitch intros 3m
28:00 - Breakout rooms A/B/C 15m
43:00 - Regroup + lightning highlights 7m
50:00 - Live Q&A panel 10m
60:00 - Close & CTA 5m
```
Kai: looks good. for breakouts we need clear 1-slide prompts + 1 demo snippet each. I can draft the prompts.
Anya: speakers confirmed: keynote Anya, breakout A Sam (cost), breakout B Mira (private), breakout C Jordan (observability). Sam/Mira/Jordan — confirm availability for rehearsal Thurs 9am PT?
Sam: I can do Thurs 9am.
Mira: works for me.
Jordan: I’m in.
ops-bot: Reminder: run-of-show doc link posted in #marketing-resources — rehearsal invite created for 2025-05-15 16:00 UTC.
Anya: Tech checklist for rehearsal: share slides in advance, test screen share + audio, demo tokens & model pinned, staging endpoint ready.
Sam: tagging infra: @Kai can you reserve a staging slot with 2x throughput for demo? need stable KV cache and ability to hit quantized model.
Kai: slot reserved. will provide endpoint: `https://staging.redwood-demo/5201` and ephemeral key during rehearsal.
Mira: for private demo, need a sanitized dataset. @Jordan can you scrub sample logs and send?
Jordan: will scrub and drop in the shared drive by EOD tomorrow.
Anya: Audience routing note — capture breakout selection on registration form (dropdown: cost, private, observability). route leads to corresponding SDR + follow-up doc.
Jordan: good call. Sam/Mira/Jordan — what is the one-line CTA for each breakout?
Sam: "Cut token spend by 3x with intelligent batching and caching."
Mira: "Deploy inference behind your VPC with compliance-first controls."
Jordan: "Detect quality regressions early with prompt-driven evals and alerts."
Anya: I'll write the landing copy + 2 social creatives once CTAs locked. aim to lock copy by Tue.
Sam: rehearsal runbook ask: please include failover plan if streaming stalls (auto-fallback to shorter demo clip).
Mira: also need a plan for audience Q triage — designate one person in each room to collect top 3 Qs for the panel.
Jordan: assigning: Sam (room A), Mira (room B), Kai (room C logistics), Anya (panel moderator).
ops-bot: Note: recording toggled on. post-event recording will land in the marketing drive.
Anya: final ask — can we get short speaker bios (<=40 words) and headshots by Mon? I’ll assemble slides.
Sam: sending bios + headshot now.
Mira: sending mine tonight.
Jordan: sending scrubbed dataset + bio tomorrow morning.
Anya: sweet. if nothing else, rehearsal agenda confirmed for Thurs 9am PT: quick tech check 10m, mock intros 10m, demo dry-run 20m, breakouts timing run 15m, wrap + contingency 5m.
Kai: noted. I’ll standby for any deploy hiccups.
Jordan: thanks everyone — will update the run-of-show doc and ping when slide folder is live. :rocket:
